editorial.thesis: A trading city of about 95,000. Its retail is heavy on restaurants & fast food and apparel, footwear & jewellery, and thin on grocery & daily needs and pharmacy & health retail — and 0% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 78% of Ludhiana's. 11.54 chain outlets per lakh residents against 14.79 in Ludhiana; 7 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by McDonald's 3, KFC 2, Burger King 2.

The mapped economy leans to shops & retail. Shares of all mapped places: shops & retail 23.1% (Ludhiana 19.7%). Raw counts would mislead because Ludhiana is mapped more completely (19,904 places against 238), so we compare mix, not counts.
No large under-served zone. No zone combines a large resident base with retail depth below 60% of the city average; the thin spots are small and scattered.
Retail is less concentrated than in Ludhiana. 36% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Ludhiana 45%). The largest core is Bhucho Mandi (132 places).

The widest brand gaps against Ludhiana. Domino's 1 outlets vs 27; Subway 1 outlets vs 20; Café Coffee Day 1 outlets vs 18. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 6 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Ludhiana, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Bhucho Mandi is the only mapped zone, with about 50,000 residents. Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 36% of all commercial places, and Bhucho Mandi alone lists 132.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Bhucho Mandi holds 7 of the 11 tracked chain outlets.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Bhucho Mandi has 19 education places and 4 coaching centres.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. There is no large amber area. The blue cores include Bhucho Mandi.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (19,904 places in Ludhiana against 238 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Ludhiana; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Ludhiana, Bathinda's mapped places over-index on shops & retail (23.1% vs 19.7%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 11 outlets of 7 tracked national brands within 6 km — 11.54 per lakh residents against Ludhiana's 14.79 (223 outlets of 36 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Ludhiana are Domino's (1 vs 27); Subway (1 vs 20); Café Coffee Day (1 vs 18). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Ludhiana's, so low means thin by Ludhiana's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 6 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Bathinda's age mix against Ludhiana: children (0–14) 22.0% vs 22.0%, 15–24 20.4% vs 19.8%, working age 47.1% vs 48.9%, 60+ 10.4% vs 9.3%. Under-25s are 42% of residents.

zones.151101: Reasonably supplied: 132 places for about 50,000 residents (index 146), 7 chain outlets.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 8.4% of mapped places against 4.4% in Ludhiana — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: McDonald's 3 (Ludhiana 10), KFC 2 (Ludhiana 16), Burger King 2 (Ludhiana 7), Domino's 1 (Ludhiana 27). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.5% of mapped places against 1.7% in Ludhiana — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 1 (Ludhiana 18). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.8% of mapped places against 0.7% in Ludhiana — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 1 (Ludhiana 7). No mapped outlet in either city: Naturals, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 0.0% of mapped places against 2.2% in Ludhiana — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Big Bazaar, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.8% of mapped places against 1.1% in Ludhiana — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 13.4% of mapped places against 7.4% in Ludhiana — above its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Zudio.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.8% of mapped places against 7.8% in Ludhiana — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 3.8% of mapped places against 2.8% in Ludhiana — above its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 4.6% of mapped places against 4.9% in Ludhiana, so the mix is level.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
